name: vite-plus
purpose: Provide one repository-level development command surface for workspace tasks, checks, future Vite builds, editor integration, and CI setup.
alternativesConsidered: Keep independent pnpm, Vite, formatter, linter, and test command surfaces
Adopt Turborepo plus standalone Vite tooling
Use Vite without the Vite Plus workspace toolchain
maintenanceStatus: Pinned initial adoption; keep pnpm and repository verification scripts authoritative until Vite Plus proves parity.
securityEvidence: Official MIT registry metadata, Node.js 24 engine support, package integrity, monorepo, editor, migration, and CI documentation were reviewed.
modifications: None; used as root development tooling.
requiredNotices: Retain the MIT license when redistributing the package.
